summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on sessionization logic, specifically regarding a potential 'magic constant' of 15 minutes. Initially, [p1] observed a sharp spike in repeated sessions for a single device using multiple sensors, which seemed unusual without filtering.
[me] clarified that the 15-minute period represents an idle time between sessions and questioned if the spike was related to session duration.
[p1] then identified the source of the issue: they had incorrectly included scenarios where both the first and subsequent sessions occurred on the same sensor, in addition to considering transitions between different sensors. This inclusion correctly accounted for the 15-minute gap, which [p1] initially misinterpreted as an anomaly.
decisions: The 15-minute period is confirmed to be the standard idle time used for sessionization.
